lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate (1) to long flange A (3), ~90 deg. The line sits on the outer-skin apex: the outermost point along the bisector is -0.02 to 0.07 mm from the line at 10 stations. Sections at 25/50/75% show the outer arc touching the line, with the hole wall only at 50%, inside the fold. The fold runs from t=0 to about 40 mm. At t=41 there is no fold, only the flange C end, and at t=-2 there are no points. The line spans 0 to 39.9 mm, so it is full length and parallel.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Plate (1) to end flange C (6), ~90 deg. The line is on the outer apex at every station (offset 0.00 to 0.06 mm). The fold exists from about t=0 to 26 mm, matching the width of flange C. Sections at t=27 and t=30 show only the plate perimeter strip, which is not a fold. The line spans 0 to 25.7 mm.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Plate (2) to back-folded flange B (5). It is an acute fold: included angle about 51 deg, bend angle about 129 deg. The line is on the outer-skin apex (offset 0.01 to 0.03 mm). Sections at 25/50/75% show a clean V with the outer arc at the line. At t=-2 only the flange is present because the plate corner notch removes the fold there. At t=36 only the plate is present, next to the flange C corner. The fold therefore runs about 0 to 35 mm, and the line spans 0 to 34.6 mm.
